## Fixes

- **A cell with both a floor and a lower wall now shows its floor, as in the game.**
  - **Before:** lower walls (the walls hanging down into a pit) were drawn over their own cell's floor. Where a floor was placed on top of a pit edge, for example the sand around the Dark Temple's pentagram, the map showed dark holes that aren't there in game.
  - **Now:** lower walls are drawn first and every floor covers them, like the game and WinDS1. Flat one-colour void floors (like the Arcane map's) still go underneath, so they don't hide the pit walls.
